dialogues.speaker: Late that night
dialogues.text: Rain rattled the windows. David was sorting drawings made by his young son, Ethan, when Amara called. Ethan's mother was whispering.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Please, David—save Ethan. Victor has taken my baby. I'm at the garden gate; the back door is open, and he left a trail. We have to follow it before dawn.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: A video flickers on David's phone. Victor looks into the camera: 'You have until dawn. Follow the trail I left, and come alone—or Ethan disappears for good.' The screen goes black.

choices.label: Call the police
choices.impact: Detective Morris leads the missing-child case. Calling him brings police to the house, but takes time to organize.
choices.response: David calls Detective Morris, the officer leading the missing-child investigation. Morris secures the house and coordinates the search.

choices.label: Trace Victor’s signal
choices.impact: Amara traces the phone signal toward the industrial district. David gets a faster lead, but has no police support.
choices.response: Amara traces the message. A weak signal points toward the industrial district, where a device may still be nearby.

choices.label: Go after Victor alone
choices.impact: David follows the prints immediately. He moves fastest, but has no backup if Victor is waiting.
choices.response: David pockets the phone and follows the muddy prints himself. Victor knows he is coming; the trail may be a trap.

metadata.notes: Opening suspense scene and choice for the first playable investigation.
